confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on 2025-2026 aggregated cost-of-living listings (Numbeo-derived sites, MyLifeElsewhere, Tulum Times) and casual-restaurant menu prices, converted at roughly 17.5 MXN per USD. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are medium confidence. Cocktail and wine_glass are lower confidence: direct local data was thin, so cocktail uses about 2.5x the beer anchor and the wine glass uses casual Tulum menu prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Tulum context, not checked against live listings or booking pages. The FX observation is the latest RBA value I could confirm; a later observation was not verified, so as_of_date may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Yucatan Peninsula coastal Mexico, priced between Playa del Carmen and budget Mexican beach towns. Tulum's beach-zone and resort-adjacent venues run well above the town-centre averages used for the inexpensive and midrange anchors.
